title: Kakariko Village as a child: the gate, Anju and her catch cuccos (row 272's real flow)

boot-arrival.note: Where the boot live-kakariko-child put Link: at the gate from Hyrule Field, not by the well.

anju.note: Anju, Npc_Hylia_049_Child, beside the steps; she says This is bad... Real bad! as Link comes near.

anju-beside.note: Link placed here stood beside Anju but faced away: the A prompt was empty. Face her (face tool) before talk.

catch-cucco-near-gate.note: One Animal_Cucco_CatchCucco near the gate; placed 0.8 m from it, A lifted it (the prompt then said Have).

children-group.note: Npc_Hylia_012/013/016_Child stand here; each gave a Talk prompt.

notes: From two lane-1 play-test runs on 2026-11-24 (anju-discover, anju-discover2; module of branch testkit-geno), one try each.
Only one catch cucco was within 500 m of the gate at that time of day in that save.

Anju's own Talk (flow Npc_Hylia_049_Child) branches first on her AI schedule action (EventQueryAIScheduleCheckActorActionAll, 27 cases): with no talk prompt she was in an action without one (time of day).
The reward talk is Minigame_CatchCucco's Ready_Npc_Hylia_049_Complete_Talk (the minigame's Ready step), then RewardFlow if MiniGame_CatchCucco_IsCompleted is false.

RewardFlow hands the bottle over, then sets Npc_Hylia_049_Child_IsCompleted, MiniGame_CatchCucco_IsCompleted and CatchCucco_ElapsedTime. Cucco state: Npc_Hylia_049_Child_Cucco0N_IsInTheCage, MiniGame_CatchCucco_InFenceCount, HowManyCuccos 7.
